newsitem.title: singapore: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.
They said activity was limited by a shortage of players in the market due to the Martin Luther King Jr. holiday in the United States.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. Some people are waiting for possible direction from outcome of (U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman) Alan Greenspan's testimony to the (U.S.) Senate on Tuesday," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent.
